body.title: About Us – Free Dot to Dot Printables for Kids
body.h1: About Us – Free Dot to Dot Printables for Kids
body.intro: DotToDotFreePrintables.com does one thing: free printable connect-the-dots worksheets for kids. No accounts, no subscriptions, no paywalls — every puzzle on this site can be downloaded as a print-ready PDF and used at home, in a homeschool, or in a classroom.
body.made: Every puzzle is designed in-house and reviewed for age-appropriate difficulty and clarity before it is published. If a dot cluster looks confusing, or a line crosses awkwardly, the page is revised until it works. Puzzles are organized by theme and by difficulty — from 32-dot pages for younger kids up to 100+ dot challenges for older kids — so there is a right level for almost every child.
body.guides: Our guides and articles are written under the pen name Mira. Mira designs and reviews every puzzle on this site for age-appropriate difficulty and clarity before it is published, and the parent and teacher guides here draw on that same review process.
body.free: Printable activities are one of the simplest screen-free tools families and teachers have, and we think the basic version of that should cost nothing. The site may show advertising to cover its costs, but the puzzles themselves are free and will stay free — no sign-up required.
body.contact: Puzzle requests, corrections, or questions are always welcome — see the contact page. You can also read our privacy policy and terms of use.
